blocks.text: Noaniq artikl: a / an

O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q: «Bu olma», «Akam shifokor», «Menda mashina bor» — ot hech qanday yordamchi so'zsiz turaveradi. Ingliz tilida esa **birlikdagi sanaladigan ot** (bitta olma, bitta mashina, bitta kasb egasi) gapda yolg'iz turolmaydi: uning oldida **a / an**, **the**, **my**, **this** kabi so'zlardan biri bo'lishi shart. Eng ko'p ishlatiladigani — **noaniq artikl a / an**. Ma'nosi «bir», «qandaydir bir» so'ziga yaqin, lekin o'zbekcha «bir» ixtiyoriy, inglizcha **a / an** esa majburiy: This is **an apple** — Bu olma.
a / an nimani bildiradi

**a / an** — «ko'pdan biri». Gapirayotgan odam narsani turi bo'yicha nomlaydi: aynan qaysi biri ekani muhim emas yoki tinglovchiga hali noma'lum. I want **a sandwich** — qandaydir bitta buterbrod, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham mayli. Shuning uchun **a / an** faqat **birlikdagi sanaladigan** ot bilan keladi: **a book** (bitta kitob), lekin books (ko'plik) yoki water (sanalmaydigan) oldida u bo'lmaydi.

O'zbekcha «bir» bilan solishtirish foydali, lekin u faqat yarim yo'lgacha ishlaydi. «Ko'chada bir odam turibdi» — **A man** is standing in the street: bu yerda mos. Ammo «Men bir o'qituvchiman» deyilmaydi, inglizchada esa I'm **a teacher** majburiy. Demak, **a / an** ni tarjimada «bir» deb berish shart emas — ko'pincha u umuman ko'rinmaydi. Teskari yo'nalishda esa qoida aniq: ot birlikda, sanaladigan va oldida my, the, this kabi so'z bo'lmasa — **a / an** qo'ying.

items.text: I need **a taxi** to the airport.

blocks.text: a yoki an? — harfga emas, tovushga qarang

**an** keyingi so'z **unli tovush** bilan boshlanganda ishlatiladi: **an apple**, **an egg**, **an idea**, **an orange**, **an umbrella**. Qolgan hamma holatda — **a**: **a book**, **a car**, **a house**. Sababi — talaffuz qulayligi: ikki unli ketma-ket kelsa, so'zlar qo'shilib ketadi, `n` ularni ajratib turadi. Eng muhimi: qoida **harfga emas, tovushga** qaraydi. Yozuvda unli harf bilan boshlangan, lekin undosh tovush bilan aytiladigan so'zlar bor — va aksincha.

Tekshirish usuli: so'zni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi eshitilgan tovush unli bo'lsa — **an**, undosh bo'lsa (jumladan «y» va «v») — **a**. Yozuvga emas, qulog'ingizga ishoning: **a** university, lekin **an** umbrella; **a** house, lekin **an** hour.
Artikl keyingi so'zga qaraydi

**a / an** otga emas, **o'zidan keyingi so'zga** qarab tanlanadi. Ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, sifatning birinchi tovushi hal qiladi: **an apple**, lekin **a red apple**; **a house**, lekin **an old house**. very, really kabi so'zlar ham shunday: **a very old house**. Artikl doim birinchi o'rinda — sifatdan ham oldin turadi: **a big city** («big a city» emas).

items.text: We stayed in **an old hotel** near the river.

blocks.text: Kasb, kim yoki nima ekanini aytish

O'zbekchada «Akam shifokor», «Bu masjid», «Toshkent — katta shahar» deyiladi. Inglizchada kimdir yoki nimadir **qaysi turga mansubligini** aytganda — kasb, narsaning nomi, tavsif — **a / an** shart: My brother is **a doctor**. That's **a mosque**. Tashkent is **a big city**. Bu yerda **a / an** «ko'p shifokorlardan biri», «masjidlardan biri» degan ma'noni beradi. Kasb qaysi fe'l bilan aytilmasin, artikl tushib qolmaydi: She works as **an accountant**. He wants to be **a pilot**.
a / an ishlatilmaydigan joylar

rows: my friend / a friend of mine
ism va shahar nomi oldida artikl yo'q (73-dars)

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm teacher.» → **I'm a teacher.**; «He is engineer.» → **He's an engineer.**; «It's a apple.» → **It's an apple.**; «an university» → **a university** (so'z «y» tovushi bilan boshlanadi); «a hour» → **an hour** (`h` o'qilmaydi); «It's a very nice.» → **It's very nice.** (ot yo'q — artikl ham yo'q). Sabab bitta: o'zbekchada artikl yo'q, shuning uchun u yo tushib qoladi, yo keraksiz joyga qo'shiladi.
a / an = «har»: twice a day

Vaqt va o'lchov birliklari bilan **a / an** «har», «-iga» ma'nosini beradi: three times **a week** — haftasiga uch marta; 60 kilometres **an hour** — soatiga 60 kilometr; 10 pounds **a kilo** — kilosi 10 funt. Bu yerda ham tanlov tovushga qarab: **an hour**, lekin **a day**.
a / an yoki one?

**a / an** ham, **one** ham «bitta», lekin **one** sonni ta'kidlaydi. I've got **a brother** — akam bor (shunchaki xabar). I've got **one brother** — bitta akam bor (ikkita emas). Odatda **a / an** yetarli; **one** son muhim bo'lganda kerak: Just **one coffee**, please — not two.
Artikllar bo'limi: ko'plik — 66-dars; sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar — 67–68-darslar; **a / an** va **the** farqi — 69-dars; **the** ning boshqa holatlari — 70-dars.

examples.title: **a** + consonant sound: **a** book, **a** car
examples.description: So'z undosh tovush bilan boshlansa — **a**. O'zbekchada bu joyda hech narsa aytilmaydi, inglizchada esa birlikdagi ot yolg'iz turmaydi.

sentences.text: Is this **a pen** or **a pencil**?
Dilnoza has got **a cat** and **a dog**.
There's **a bank** next to our school.
My father wants to buy **a car** this year.
Can I have **a cup** of tea, please?
We live in **a house** with a small garden.
sentences.translation: Biz kichkina bog'i bor **hovli uyda** yashaymiz.

sentences.text: Tom is reading **a book** about the history of Samarkand.
Look, there's **a bird** on the balcony!
Every Sunday Aziz writes **a letter** to his grandmother in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Aziz har yakshanba Buxorodagi buvisiga **xat** yozadi.

sentences.text: I'm looking for **a job**, but it isn't easy in this city.
sentences.translation: **Ish** qidiryapman, lekin bu shaharda topish oson emas.

examples.title: **an** + vowel sound: **an** apple, **an** egg
examples.description: So'z unli tovush bilan boshlansa — **an**: an apple, an egg, an idea, an office, an umbrella. `n` ikki unlini ajratib, talaffuzni osonlashtiradi.

sentences.text: Would you like **an apple** or **a banana**?
I eat **an egg** for breakfast every morning.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab nonushtaga **bitta tuxum** yeyman.

sentences.text: Madina has got **an older brother** and two younger sisters.
Oh no, it's raining and I haven't got **an umbrella**!
sentences.translation: Voy, yomg'ir yog'yapti, mening esa **soyabonim** yo'q!

sentences.text: There's **an airport** about twenty kilometres from the city.
sentences.translation: Shahardan taxminan yigirma kilometr narida **aeroport** bor.

sentences.text: James had **an idea**: let's go to Oxford by train!
sentences.translation: Jeymsning xayoliga **bir fikr** keldi: Oksfordga poyezdda boraylik!

sentences.text: My uncle works in **an office** in the centre of Tashkent.
Is there **an Italian restaurant** near here?
After the concert every child got **an ice cream**.
sentences.translation: Konsertdan keyin har bir bola **muzqaymoq** oldi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I don't understand — can you give me **an example**?

examples.title: Tricky sounds: **a** university, **an** hour
examples.description: Harfga emas, tovushga qarang: university, uniform, European, one «y» yoki «v» tovushi bilan boshlanadi — **a**; hour, honest, honour da `h` o'qilmaydi — **an**.

sentences.text: My sister studies at **a university** in London.
Hurry up! The train leaves in **an hour**.
Every pupil at this school wears **a uniform**.
sentences.translation: Bu maktabda har bir o'quvchi **forma** kiyadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is **an honest man** — he never tells lies.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **halol odam** — u hech qachon yolg'on gapirmaydi.

sentences.text: Can I have **a one-way ticket** to Samarkand, please?
Prague is **a European capital** with a long history.
The doctor says I need **an X-ray** of my arm.
This is **a useful website** for students who learn English.
sentences.translation: Bu ingliz tilini o'rganayotgan talabalar uchun **foydali sayt**.

sentences.text: We waited for the bus for half **an hour** in the rain.
Last month Aziz bought **a used car** from **an old friend** of his father.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy Aziz otasining **eski do'stidan** **ishlatilgan mashina** sotib oldi.

examples.title: Jobs: she's **a nurse**, he's **an engineer**
examples.description: Kasb oldida doim **a / an**: «Onam hamshira» — My mother is **a nurse**. work as, want to be, become dan keyin ham artikl tushib qolmaydi.

sentences.text: My mother is **a nurse** at a children's hospital.
What does your dad do for a living? — He's **an engineer** at a factory.
sentences.translation: Dadangiz nima ish qiladi? — U zavodda **muhandis**.

sentences.text: Madina wants to become **an architect** one day.
sentences.translation: Madina bir kun kelib **arxitektor** bo'lishni xohlaydi.

sentences.text: Is James **a lawyer**? — No, he's **an accountant**.
I'm not **a student** now — I work as **a taxi driver**.
sentences.translation: Men endi **talaba** emasman — **taksi haydovchisi** bo'lib ishlayman.

sentences.text: Her husband is **an artist**, and she's **a singer**.
Many years ago my grandfather was **a farmer** in a village near Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ko'p yillar oldin bobom Farg'ona yaqinidagi qishloqda **dehqon** bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Aziz works as **an electrician**, so he can fix almost anything.
sentences.translation: Aziz **elektrik** bo'lib ishlaydi, shuning uchun deyarli hamma narsani tuzata oladi.

sentences.text: When I was **a child**, I wanted to be **an astronaut**.
Sarah is **a police officer**, and her brother is **a firefighter**.

examples.title: **a/an** + adjective + noun: **an old** house
examples.description: Ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, artikl sifatga qarab tanlanadi: **an** apple, lekin **a** red apple; **a** house, lekin **an** old house. Artikl doim sifatdan oldin turadi.

sentences.text: Samarkand is **an old city** with beautiful buildings.
What **a nice day**! Let's go to the park.
We had **an amazing holiday** in Turkey last summer.
Bekzod is **a very careful driver**.
Is London **an expensive city**? — Yes, very.
This is **an unusual name** — where is it from?
Grandpa tells us **an interesting story** every evening.
sentences.translation: Bobom har kuni kechqurun bizga **qiziq hikoya** aytib beradi.

sentences.text: Aziz isn't **an English teacher**, he's **a Russian teacher**.
sentences.translation: Aziz **ingliz tili o'qituvchisi** emas, u **rus tili o'qituvchisi**.

sentences.text: We didn't stay in **an expensive hotel** — we found **a cheap hostel** near the station.
sentences.translation: Biz **qimmat mehmonxonada** to'xtamadik — vokzal yaqinidan **arzon hostel** topdik.

sentences.text: It was **an awful film**, but we had **a great evening** together.
sentences.translation: **Film** juda **yomon** edi, lekin birga **ajoyib oqshom** o'tkazdik.

examples.title: What is it? — It's **a** ...
examples.description: Savol va qisqa javob: narsa yoki odam nima ekanini so'rash va aytish. Javobda ham ot oldida **a / an** turadi: It's **a mosque**. He's **an actor**.

sentences.text: What's that building? — It's **a mosque**.
Is this **a hotel**? — No, it's **a hospital**.
Have you got **a phone charger**? — Yes, there's one in my bag.
sentences.translation: Sizda **telefon quvvatlagichi** bormi? — Ha, sumkamda bor.

sentences.text: Is Dilnoza **a teacher**? — Yes, she is, at a music school.
What's **an owl**? — It's **a bird** with very big eyes.
Do you live in **a house** or **a flat**? — In **a flat**.
Is there **a pharmacy** on this street? — Yes, next to the bank.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'chada **dorixona** bormi? — Ha, bankning yonida.

sentences.text: Do you think Bukhara is **a big city**? — No, it's quite small.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Buxoro **katta shahar**mi? — Yo'q, ancha kichik.

sentences.text: What does Tom do? — He's **an actor**, but he isn't famous.
sentences.translation: Tom nima ish qiladi? — U **aktyor**, lekin mashhur emas.

sentences.text: Are you **an only child**? — No, I've got two brothers.
sentences.translation: Siz oilada **yolg'iz farzand**misiz? — Yo'q, ikkita akam bor.

examples.title: **a/an** = every: twice **a day**, 60 km **an hour**
examples.description: Vaqt va o'lchov bilan **a / an** «har», «-iga» ma'nosida: twice **a day** — kuniga ikki marta, 60 km **an hour** — soatiga 60 km, 10 pounds **a kilo** — kilosi 10 funt.

sentences.text: I go to the gym three times **a week**.
Take this medicine twice **a day** after meals.
sentences.translation: Bu dorini ovqatdan keyin **kuniga** ikki marta iching.

sentences.text: The speed limit here is 60 kilometres **an hour**.
Bekzod earns about 800 dollars **a month**.
We visit our grandparents in Namangan once **a year**.
sentences.translation: Namangandagi bobom va buvimnikiga **yilda** bir marta boramiz.

sentences.text: These apples cost 15,000 sum **a kilo**.
How many hours **a day** do you sleep?
Sarah checks her email ten times **an hour** at work!
sentences.translation: Sara ishda elektron pochtasini **soatiga** o'n marta tekshiradi!

sentences.text: In summer we go swimming four or five times **a week**.
The rent is 500 pounds **a month**, and that's cheap for London.
sentences.translation: Ijara haqi **oyiga** 500 funt, bu London uchun arzon.

examples.title: Dialogue: meeting **a** new neighbour
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kasb, tavsif (**an** important job), «har» ma'nosi (**a** day) va tovushga qarab **a / an** tanlash (**an** Uzbek teapot).

sentences.text: — Hello! I'm Emma. I live in **a flat** upstairs.
sentences.translation: — Salom! Men Emmaman. Yuqori qavatdagi **kvartirada** yashayman.

sentences.text: — Nice to meet you! I'm Aziz, **an exchange student** from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: — Tanishganimdan xursandman! Men Azizman, Toshkentdan kelgan **almashinuv talabasiman**.

sentences.text: — Oh, great! Are you at **a university** here?
— Yes, I'm studying to be **an engineer**.
— Interesting! My dad is **an architect**, so I love buildings too.
sentences.translation: — Qiziq! Dadam **arxitektor**, shuning uchun men ham binolarni yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: — And you? Do you work, or are you **a student** too?
— I'm **a nurse**. I work twelve hours **a day** at the hospital.
sentences.translation: — Men **hamshiraman**. Shifoxonada **kuniga** o'n ikki soat ishlayman.

sentences.text: — That's **a long day**! Is it **a difficult job**?
— Sometimes, but it's **an important job**, and I love it.
sentences.translation: — Ba'zan, lekin bu **muhim ish**, men uni yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: — Then come for tea one evening — I've got **an Uzbek teapot**!
sentences.translation: — Unda bir kuni kechqurun choyga keling — menda **o'zbek choynagi** bor!
